name: Sistermon Blanc
main_effect:
[On Play] By trashing 1 card in your hand, ＜Draw 2＞ (Draw 2 cards from your deck.)
[All Turns] While you have a Digimon in play with [Huckmon] in its name or [Royal Knight] trait, this Digimon gains ＜Decoy (Red/Black)＞ (When your other Red or Black Digimon would be deleted by an opponent's effect, you may delete this Digimon to prevent 1 of those Digimon's deletion.)
